entities.name: Isaac Komnenos of Cyprus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isaac Doukas Komnenos was a claimant to the Byzantine Empire and the ruler of Cyprus from 1185 to 1191. Contemporary sources commonly refer to him as the emperor of Cyprus. He lost the island to King Richard I of England during the Third Crusade.
